strong_claim_requires: line-level staged files downloaded and hashed
locked train/validation separation by source and release date
prospective release holdout after model freeze
functional or structural confirmation for top targets

registry.independence_role: core clinical supervision plus release-frozen expert-panel holdout
registry.validation_value: Release-frozen clinical labels, review status, expert-panel separation, and prospective release cutoffs.
registry.caveat: Avoid leakage: expert or newest releases should be locked away from training when used as validation.

registry.independence_role: FDA-recognized expert assertions for adjudication and holdout checks
registry.validation_value: Independent expert assertions and provenance can verify whether PrimeVarClass generalizes beyond ClinVar-only labels.
registry.caveat: Use as external validation unless a deliberate, versioned training release is created.

registry.independence_role: BRCA-specific expert adjudication and conflict resolution
registry.download_url_hint: stage BRCA Exchange or ENIGMA-derived release file locally
registry.validation_value: Strong BRCA-specific independent expert source for the first high-impact disease area.
registry.caveat: Confirm redistribution and release terms before bundling raw tables.

registry.independence_role: population rarity, ancestry-aware frequency, and constraint control
registry.download_url_hint: use gene-filtered browser table, Hail table, or GraphQL/toolbox extraction
registry.validation_value: Population allele frequency is essential for pathogenicity calibration and rare-variant plausibility.
registry.caveat: Full files are large; freeze release and ancestry fields before publication claims.

registry.independence_role: experimental variant-effect evidence for mechanism and calibration
registry.download_url_hint: use public score-set CSVs, mapped variants, or bulk release dump
registry.validation_value: Direct functional effect data helps discover mechanism and evaluate predictions beyond labels.
registry.caveat: Assays differ by gene, domain, and cellular context; benchmark by assay family when possible.

registry.independence_role: independent proteome-wide missense prior for comparator analyses
registry.download_url_hint: stage AlphaMissense_hg38.tsv.gz or amino-acid substitution subset
registry.validation_value: Useful for head-to-head comparison and cases where prime features disagree with a strong external predictor.
registry.caveat: Do not use predictor scores as ground truth labels.

registry.independence_role: reviewed sequence, accession, domain, and function backbone
registry.validation_value: Protein context anchors structural, proteomic, and quantum modules to stable accessions.
registry.caveat: Freeze accession and isoform mapping for each benchmark release.

registry.independence_role: 3D model prior for residue environment, fragments, and quantum target selection
registry.download_url_hint: stage accession-specific model metadata and coordinate URLs
registry.validation_value: Connects variant predictions to 3D residue neighborhoods and protein-fragment engines.
registry.caveat: Predicted structures are not experimental validation; use PDB or lab confirmation when possible.

registry.independence_role: experimental structural evidence around domains, interfaces, and ligands
registry.download_url_hint: stage Data API/Search API structure metadata by accession/gene
registry.validation_value: Experimental structures strengthen mechanistic interpretation and drug-discovery target selection.
registry.caveat: Coverage can be fragmentary; require residue/domain overlap checks.

registry.independence_role: curated disease, therapy, and evidence items for cancer variants
registry.download_url_hint: nightly or historical monthly TSV/VCF release
registry.validation_value: Adds translational oncology actionability without turning actionability into a pathogenicity label.
registry.caveat: Research use only; do not present as clinical medical advice.

registry.independence_role: independent tumor cohorts and study-level cancer mutation context
registry.download_url_hint: download selected public study folders, e.g. public/brca_tcga
registry.validation_value: Tests cross-context signal in tumor cohorts for cancer genes such as BRCA1, TP53, PTEN, MSH2, and KRAS.
registry.caveat: Somatic recurrence is a different endpoint from germline pathogenicity.

registry.independence_role: large cancer-genomics cohort context and clinical metadata
registry.download_url_hint: use open MAF/project metadata via GDC API; controlled files require dbGaP
registry.validation_value: Adds an independent, clinically annotated cancer-context layer for translational claims.
registry.caveat: Keep controlled-access and open-access cohorts separated in all manifests.

registry.download_url_hint: REST API by trait, variant, study, or mapped gene
registry.validation_value: Supports biological plausibility, disease breadth, and target-discovery narratives.
registry.caveat: Association evidence is not functional causality or variant pathogenicity.

registry.download_url_hint: GraphQL API or bulk data filtered by target/disease/variant
registry.validation_value: Strengthens translational target selection and mechanism-to-disease mapping.
registry.caveat: Aggregate scores require source-level evidence audit for strong scientific claims.

registry.download_url_hint: ClinPGx API or PharmGKB bulk downloads under applicable terms
registry.validation_value: Adds drug-response and pharmacogenomic context for translational reports.
registry.caveat: Often not disease-pathogenicity evidence; keep as a separate translational lane.

registry.independence_role: gene-centered observations and curated locus-specific repositories
registry.download_url_hint: stage gene-specific export after database-level QC
registry.validation_value: Can expose population- or locus-specific evidence not captured in broad aggregators.
registry.caveat: Different LOVD installations have different schemas and curation depth.

training_validation_plan.objective: Download or stage every source into a versioned, hashed local release.
training_validation_plan.success_criterion: Manifest has source URL, release, hash, row count, schema preset, and access terms.
training_validation_plan.claim_boundary: No model claim yet; this is data governance.

training_validation_plan.objective: Train only on allowed clinical-label cohorts and separate expert/newer releases.
training_validation_plan.success_criterion: Training labels are release-frozen and leakage checks pass against external holdouts.
training_validation_plan.claim_boundary: Computational model claim only; no clinical-use claim.

training_validation_plan.objective: Evaluate held-out expert, BRCA-specific, locus-specific, and prospective release cohorts.
training_validation_plan.sources: ClinGen ERepo; BRCA Exchange/ENIGMA; LOVD; newest ClinVar release
training_validation_plan.success_criterion: AUC/PR/MCC/calibration hold across sources and genes without training contamination.
training_validation_plan.claim_boundary: Supports scientific credibility if confidence intervals and no-regression gates pass.

training_validation_plan.objective: Triangulate predictions with MAVE, structural, protein, and quantum evidence.
training_validation_plan.sources: MaveDB; AlphaMissense; UniProt; AlphaFold DB; RCSB PDB
training_validation_plan.success_criterion: High-risk predictions show consistent functional/structural signal or explainable disagreement.
training_validation_plan.claim_boundary: Mechanistic insight is hypothesis-generating until lab-confirmed.

training_validation_plan.objective: Test disease breadth and actionability without using actionability as pathogenicity labels.
training_validation_plan.sources: CIViC; cBioPortal; GDC; GWAS Catalog; Open Targets; PharmGKB
training_validation_plan.success_criterion: Cancer, disease, and drug-evidence layers improve prioritization and reporting traceability.
training_validation_plan.claim_boundary: Translational prioritization claim only; not treatment recommendation.

training_validation_plan.objective: Lock a model, wait for new public releases, then evaluate unseen variants prospectively.
training_validation_plan.success_criterion: Pre-registered endpoints pass on variants absent from the locked training timestamp.
training_validation_plan.claim_boundary: This is the strongest route toward publication-grade independent validation.
